name: Fentanyl carbamate
summary: Fentanyl carbamate (Fentanyl ethyl carbamate, Fentanyl ethylformate) is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of fentanyl and has been sold as a designer drug. It has only around 1/10th the potency of fentanyl, but this still makes it a comparatively potent opioid agonist.
